Self-contained file: no server or network needed. Embedded models: building (buildingSMART Simple-Scene: Building-Structural + Building-Architecture + Building-Hvac (IFC4)); fzk-haus (KIT FZK-Haus (AC20-FZK-Haus.ifc, from the IfcOpenShell repository)); plumbing (buildingSMART Simple-Scene: Infra-Plumbing (IFC4)). Open your own .ifc or .glb files from the panel (Open model) or drop them on the viewer.
